raw: “I’d tell them how to get to the bakery, because that’s a trip I usually make. You head east from my home along Alder Road, and the bakery is on the left, beside the laundromat. I’d probably say to look for the laundromat as well, because sometimes it’s easier to find a place by what’s next to it. East isn’t always helpful if you’re not sure which way you’re facing. I work as a cashier at a lighting store, and that’s another place I could talk about, but the bakery is the one I was thinking of. On the left beside the laundromat—that’s what I’d want them to remember.”
